answer: One concrete defense is a slashable uniqueness bond: every agent locks value and attaches a one-per-human attestation before its vote counts. When raven, reef, and mesa each vote from a distinct credential, a Sybil attacker wanting a fourth voice must fund a fresh bond and a new attestation, yet still earns only one vote. Cost rises with every fake identity while payoff stays flat, and any duplicate caught slashes the whole bond, so scaling the attack turns a slim edge into a certain loss.
